summary: Universal stat-label adapter testing complete. All 12 Jest unit tests pass. All 13 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend e2e confirms clean short-form labels (PTS, REB, AST, PRA, P+R, H+R+RBI, Hits, Ks) are displayed throughout the app. No raw stat_type strings (player_points_rebounds_assists, batter_hits_runs_rbis, etc.) found in DOM.

notes: HTTP2 protocol errors observed in console (net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR) - related to headshot image loading, not affecting core functionality

tests: getStatLabel — NBA core markets (player_points→PTS, player_rebounds→REB, etc.)
getStatLabel — NBA combo markets (player_points_rebounds_assists→PRA, player_points_rebounds→P+R, etc.)
getStatLabel — NBA alternate suffix collapses (player_points_alternate→PTS, player_points_rebounds_alternate→P+R)
getStatLabel — MLB batter markets (batter_hits→Hits, batter_hits_runs_rbis→H+R+RBI, etc.)
getStatLabel — MLB pitcher markets (pitcher_strikeouts→Ks, pitcher_outs→Outs, etc.)
getStatLabel — already-collapsed short codes pass through (PTS→PTS, PRA→PRA)
getStatLabel — humanizes unknown markets (player_some_new_market→Some New Market)
getStatLongLabel — MLB long forms (batter_strikeouts→Strikeouts, batter_home_runs→Home Runs)
getStatLongLabel — falls back to short label when no long form registered

critical_code_review_comments: Universal stat-label adapter correctly implemented in /app/frontend/src/utils/statLabel.js
All components (CommandPost, PlayerDetailPage, MarketMoves, Dashboard) import from utils/statLabel
No sport-specific frontend formatter branches - single getStatLabel() helper handles all sports
No inline .replace() chains in components - all transformations go through the adapter
